newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bonds underperform in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds underperform in thin trade.

text.p: SYDNEY, Dec 23 (Reuter) Australian bonds underperformed the dollar bloc as the local market drifted lower during an extremely thin session.
The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread was testing resistance at 110 basis points as domestic stock weakened amid odd-lot selling after taking its initial lead from U.S. Treasuries.

The U.S. market succumbed to profit-taking on Friday after a hefty rally in the previous session and amid disappointment that minutes from the November FOMC meeting showed officials retaining a tighter bias.
While the local market was easing in a slow market, Canadian debt rallied strongly on Friday in an equally illiquid market and artifically outperformed the dollar bloc, traders said.
Meanwhile, New Zealand bonds closed little changed, supported by a NZ$200 million Eurobond launch by the World Bank.
